claims: The 2026 Masters Tournament runs from April 6–12, 2026.
The 2026 Masters Tournament is at Augusta National Golf Club.
Competitive rounds of the 2026 Masters Tournament begin on Thursday, April 9.
Practice rounds for the 2026 Masters Tournament are on April 6–8.
The Par 3 Contest for the 2026 Masters Tournament is on Wednesday, April 8.
Tournament play for the 2026 Masters Tournament finishes on Sunday, April 12.
TV coverage for Round 1 of the 2026 Masters Tournament on Thursday, April 9 starts at 3 p.m. ET on ESPN.
TV coverage for Round 2 of the 2026 Masters Tournament on Friday, April 10 starts at 3 p.m. ET on ESPN.
TV coverage for Round 3 of the 2026 Masters Tournament on Saturday, April 11 starts at 2 p.m. ET on CBS.
TV coverage for Round 4 of the 2026 Masters Tournament on Sunday, April 12 starts at 2 p.m. ET on CBS.
ESPN provides TV coverage for Thursday-Friday of the 2026 Masters Tournament.
CBS provides TV coverage for Saturday-Sunday of the 2026 Masters Tournament.
Streaming for the 2026 Masters Tournament is available on Paramount+, ESPN+, Prime Video, and Masters.com.
Featured Groups and Holes are available daily on Masters.com and the Masters App for the 2026 Masters Tournament.
First-round tee times on Thursday, April 9 for the 2026 Masters Tournament begin in the morning.
Featured groups including Scottie Scheffler and Rory McIlroy are scheduled for the afternoon on Thursday, April 9 for the 2026 Masters Tournament.
